description: This file defines the ItemsEncryptionService class, which manages encryption and decryption of item payloads in a secure application. It handles operations such as re-encrypting all items, selecting appropriate encryption keys based on user version and protocol, and decrypting payloads with fallback mechanisms. The class interacts with item, payload, storage, and event bus interfaces to orchestrate encryption workflows.

classes.name: ItemsEncryptionService
classes.description: A service class that provides encryption and decryption functionalities for items, managing encryption keys, handling payload encryption/decryption, and observing item changes to re-encrypt or decrypt as needed.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Cleans up resources, removes observers, and calls the parent deinit method.

methods.name: rerwriteAllItems
methods.description: Re-persist all items to disk with latest encryption status, typically called when encryption settings change.

methods.name: getItemsKeys
methods.description: Returns a list of displayable item keys currently managed.

methods.name: itemsKeyForPayload
methods.description: Finds the item key associated with a given encrypted payload.

methods.name: getDefaultItemsKey
methods.description: Retrieves the default item key used for encryption, if available.

methods.name: keyToUseForItemEncryption
methods.description: Determines the appropriate key to use for encrypting items based on user version and available keys.

methods.name: keyToUseForDecryptionOfPayload
methods.description: Selects the key to decrypt a specific payload, based on payload's key ID or fallback on protocol version.

methods.name: encryptPayloadWithKeyLookup
methods.description: Encrypts a payload by selecting the appropriate key via internal logic.

methods.name: encryptPayload
methods.description: Encrypts a decrypted payload with a specified item key.

methods.name: encryptPayloads
methods.description: Encrypts multiple payloads with a specified key.

methods.name: encryptPayloadsWithKeyLookup
methods.description: Encrypts multiple payloads, choosing encryption keys internally.

methods.name: decryptPayloadWithKeyLookup
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted payload, selecting the key internally if possible.

methods.name: decryptPayload
methods.description: Decrypts a payload with a specified key.

methods.name: decryptPayloadsWithKeyLookup
methods.description: Decrypts multiple payloads with key selection logic.

methods.name: decryptPayloads
methods.description: Decrypts multiple payloads using a provided key.

methods.name: decryptErroredPayloads
methods.description: Attempts to decrypt payloads that previously failed decryption, and updates the payload manager accordingly.

methods.name: defaultItemsKeyForItemVersion
methods.description: Provides the default items key for a given protocol version, considering prior keys.

methods.name: getDiagnostics
methods.description: Provides diagnostic info about encryption keys and current encryption state.
